messages.content: Help me determine the value to be used for a property named 'maxItems' in a configuration object, given that the default value is 10 and the object value 12 , but the configuration object does not explicitly define 'maxItems'?

function.name: assignOwnDefaults
function.description: This function determines the value to be assigned to a property in an object, preferring the object's own value if it exists and is not undefined, otherwise using a source value. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

objectValue.description: The value of the property in the object. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

sourceValue.description: The default or source value to use if the object's value is undefined or the object does not have its own property for the key. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

key.description: The key of the property to check in the object. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

object.description: The object to check for the property. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.
